title: Agents-MCP — workflow completo
summary: Fluxo ponta a ponta agents-mcp: captura, Developer task-id, dual-gate QA/Security, DevOps RC, hotfix.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  Start([Entrada: prompt ou captura autonoma]) --> Discover[issue-queue-discovery]
  Discover --> Type{Tipo prioritario?}
  Type -->|hotfix| P1[P1 hotfix]
  Type -->|qa ou security rejected| P2[P2 retomada]
  Type -->|bug| P3[P3 bug]
  Type -->|feature enhancement| P4[P4 demais]
  P1 --> Branch
  P2 --> Branch
  P3 --> Branch
  P4 --> Branch
  Branch[Branch task-id a partir de master] --> Impl[Implementar e testar]
  Impl --> Sync[Sincronizar origin/master]
  Sync --> MergeDev[Merge task-id em dev sem PR]
  MergeDev --> Handoff[Labels agent:qa e agent:security]
  Handoff --> Review{QA e Security}
  Review -->|rejected| Fix[Corrigir na mesma task-id]
  Fix --> Impl
  Review -->|dual accepted| Dual[agent:qa:accepted + agent:security:accepted]
  Dual --> Pack[DevOps empacota RC em staging]
  Pack --> InReview[Coluna In Review]
  InReview --> Human{Humano aprova?}
  Human -->|Deploy| Publish[staging para master e Done]
  Human -->|rejeita| Pack
  Publish --> Docs[Handoff documentadores]
  HF[label hotfix] --> HFDev[Developer merge em dev]
  HFDev --> HFStg[task-id em staging]
  HFStg --> HFReview[In Review]
  HFReview --> Human
